# TASK #3 (INFORM): SEPARATION/ETS PHYSICALS RESPONSIBILITY

**Affected Unit/Staff:** HHBN, 1-82 FA, 3-16 FAR, 2-82 FA, 6-56 ADAR
**NLT Dates:** EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY
**BLUF:** Effective immediately, BN PAs will be responsible for Separation/ETS physicals for their respective Battalions.

## 1. SITUATION
SMRC is experiencing civilian staffing shortages until DHA contract services can hire replacements.

## 2. EXECUTION

### a. Concept of the Operation
1st Cavalry Division rapidly adapts to medical staffing constraints by decentralizing separation physicals to the Battalion level.

### b. Tasks to Subordinate Units
#### All
1. Realign Separation/ETS physical workflows from SMRC to respective BN PAs.

### c. Coordinating Instructions
1. Do not send Soldiers for walk-in/uncoordinated physicals.

## 3. COMMAND AND SIGNAL

### a. Command
### b. Signal
